name: Scary Gourmet
source:
It's a big night for Wingston and Barktholomew, two dads excited to see their daughter Baella return from college, just in time for a nice, vegan Halloween dinner. But their best laid plans are thrown to the winds by the appearance of an unexpected guest - for their daughter has decided to bring along her new girlfriend, a young lady from a well-to-do witching family, with the refined tastes to match a girl of her station!

Now, with the moon quickly rising and the cauldron bubbling over, Wingston and Barktholomew will have to pull off the best dinner they can to impress this mystery girl. Tensions run high, anxieties even higher, but should it all fall apart, how will this family come back together?

[from [url=https://tinysamm.itch.io/scary-gourmet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
對溫斯頓與巴克索羅繆這兩位爸爸來說，今晚意義非凡。他們興奮地盼著女兒貝拉從大學回家，一起享用一頓美味的純素萬聖節晚餐。然而，一位意外來客的出現，打亂了所有精心安排。女兒決定帶上新交的女朋友，而這位出身富裕女巫家庭的年輕小姐，有著與身分相稱的挑剔品味！

月亮迅速升起，大鍋裡的東西也快煮滾溢出來了。溫斯頓與巴克索羅繆必須竭盡所能，做出最棒的晚餐，給這位神秘姑娘留下好印象。氣氛越來越緊張，焦慮更是不斷攀升。可如果一切都搞砸了，這個家庭又該如何重歸和睦？
